detail.longDescription: Nvidia’s Revenue Rises by 106% to $96.2 Billion as AI Demand Continues to Thrive # technology # artificialintelligence # business Nvidia delivers record Q2 revenue of $96.2B, up 106% year over year, driven by data center and AI infrastructure demand. The company also unveils Vera Rubin production and new Vera CPU, signaling a broader AI infrastructure strategy.
